explanation: LR(1) parser splits states based on lookaheads, resulting in significantly more states than LALR(1) or SLR(1), which merge states with identical core items.
All options represent standard loop transformation and optimization techniques.

Leaders are: 1 (entry statement), 2 (target of goto at 4), 3 (statement following conditional branch at 2), 5 (target of conditional branch at 2). Blocks are: Block 1 (line 1), Block 2 (line 2), Block 3 (lines 3-4), Block 4 (line 5). Total basic blocks = 4.
